# Changelog

All notable changes follow Keep a Changelog conventions. Releases use Semantic Versioning.

## Unreleased

### Added

- Composite Action metadata and a typed, secret-safe Python runner.
- Project-scoped issue, pull-request, discussion, release, push, and generic context handoff.
- Optional checkpoint restoration, Markdown summaries, and SHA-pinned artifact upload.
- Offline integration proofs for checkpoint validity, non-empty context, graph counts, external-call blocking, and secret absence.
